messages:
marta: quick handoff — leaving for the evening, holding the 24h oncall. main watch: prefetch/cache layer showing intermittent miss bursts that correlate with small latency blips. not an incident, but noisy alerts have been flapping over last 6h.

ops-bot: ALERT: prefetched_kv_miss_rate > 5% (5/10m) — affected: pref-01,pref-02 — probe: cache-metrics — see: https://grafana.redwood/prefetch/overview

sam: noted. where's the deck for the mitigation options? is this the same pattern as last month?

marta: similar surface but different trigger. last month we had an autoscale race; this time it's small prefetch evictions when throughput bursts hit a specific keyspace. looks like prefetch index rebuilds + heavy short-lived queries.

elliot: ok. is it safe to silence the alert at signal-level? it's noisy and causing rotation churn.

marta: prefer to keep it unmuted but add a suppress-if-low-impact rule. i've left a playbook link with thresholds: https://internal.redwood/sop/handbook/prefetch-fuzz. short term: set suppress for 10m if error-rate < 0.5% and p90 latency < 60ms.

ryan: i'll do the suppress now. tagging @sam for quick review of the rule before applying.

sam: +1. can you paste the rule snippet?

ryan: ```
alert: PrefetchMissBurst
if: rate(prefetch_miss[5m]) > 0.05
and: (p90(prefetch_latency) < 0.06 and error_rate < 0.005)
for: 10m
action: suppress_to_pagerduty: false
```

marta: thanks. two follow-ups i left for whoever picks this up: 1) check the pref-02 eviction logs around 18:10–18:30 (suspect index rebuilds). 2) watch the kv-autoscaler queue lengths; if they spike, we may need to throttle the rebuilds.

elliot: i'll grab the logs and post a short summary.

ops-bot: NOTE: pref-02 log-rotation completed at 18:22 UTC — job: logrotate-v2 — result: OK

sam: quick heads up — i'm OOO tomorrow morning until 11:30PT, but reachable by DM for urgent. i'll take follow-up after 12:00 if still flaky.

marta: thanks. ryan, you're primary for first 4h — escalation to me if we see sustained p99 > 250ms or >2% miss.

ryan: got it. will also watch the canary traffic group. ping me if you see any fallbacks triggered.

marta: small dev request too — i left a tiny PR to add a guard in the prefetch indexer to avoid duplicate rebuild kicks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prefetch/pull/342 — it's low risk but would cut this pattern down if merged. can someone give a quick CR?

elliot: i'll take the CR after i finish the logs. should be short.

sam: pinged the infra team to confirm there's no ongoing maintenance that matched the time window.

marta: final note: i'm keeping the runbook open under my name — if anything escalates call me. otherwise set the suppress rule as discussed and we should be fine to ride it out.

ryan: suppress applied (id: sup-202603) — monitoring closely.

elliot: logs looked noisy but no obvious error stack — posted a 4-line summary in #eng-logs.

sam: thanks all. i'll catch up after 11:30 to validate dashboard rates and close the loop. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks team — handing off. :wave:
